en.headline: Woman in her 60s injured by falling metal fragment on Ap Liu Street
en.dek: Police seized a roughly 5cm by 3cm piece after a woman walking with her mother was struck on the head near a building in Sham Shui Po and taken to Caritas Medical Centre.
body: A woman in her 60s suffered a head injury on Sunday afternoon after a metal fragment fell from height and struck her while she was walking with her mother on Ap Liu Street in Sham Shui Po.

The incident occurred around 4:30pm near No. 1 Ap Liu Street. Reports said the woman was conscious after the impact and was taken to Caritas Medical Centre for treatment following bandaging at the scene. Her mother was uninjured.

Police said a preliminary investigation indicated the object was a metal piece measuring about 5 centimetres by 3 centimetres. Officers recovered the fragment and are examining where it came from. Blood was visible on the pavement outside a ground-floor shop.

zh.headline: 深水埔鴨寮街金屬碎片墮下 六旬女子頭部受傷送院
zh.dek: 警方指初步調查相信是一塊約5厘米乘3厘米金屬碎片，女子與母親途經時被擊中，清醒送往明愛醫院。
body: 一名六十多歲女子周日下午在深水埔鴨寮街途經時，遭高處墮下的金屬碎片擊中頭部受傷。
事發約下午4時半，地點在鴨寮街1號大廈對開。女子當時與母親同行，頭部受傷流血，現場包紮後由救護車送往明愛醫院，送院時清醒；其母沒有受傷。
警方表示，初步調查相信肇事物件是一塊面積約5厘米乘3厘米的金屬碎片，已檢走涉事碎片，正調查從何處跌下。現場地面遺有血跡。
